title: Adjuster Authorization of a Functional Capacity Evaluation — Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Adjuster authorization of a Functional Capacity Evaluation

**Recording rule.** An adjuster authorizing a Functional Capacity Evaluation under a Workers' Compensation Referral records the authorization in person on the referral with the adjuster's own authorization reference and the first and last dates it covers, authorizing the requested evaluation hours and evaluation sessions; the referral's authorization reference, end date and sessions per week then follow that authorization.

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Who records it | the adjuster, in person, on the Functional Capacity Evaluation referral |
| Reference | the adjuster's own authorization reference |
| Dates | the first and last dates the authorization covers |
| What it authorizes | the requested evaluation hours and evaluation sessions |
| After recording | the referral's authorization reference, end date and sessions per week follow the authorization |

## The adjuster's recording tool: `record_fce_authorization_83d13911`

**Capability.** The claims adjuster records, in person, the adjuster's own authorization of a Functional Capacity Evaluation on the referral: the evaluation hours and sessions authorized and the dates the authorization covers. One call adds one adjuster authorization to the referral's history. The referral's authorization in force becomes this one (reference, end date and sessions per week), and its count of authorized evaluation hours still unused rises by the hours authorized.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `record_fce_authorization_83d13911` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the claims adjuster on the line — runs it in person.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wc_case_id` | the reference number of the Functional Capacity Evaluation referral being authorized, read out to the adjuster by the clinic from the referral lookup | identifier |
| `auth_reference` | the adjuster's own authorization reference | exactly as the adjuster states it, character for character, letters, digits and punctuation unchanged |
| `hours` | the evaluation hours authorized | non-negative whole number of hours; no fractions and no empty value |
| `sessions` | the evaluation sessions per Monday-to-Sunday week the authorization allows | non-negative whole number; no fractions and no empty value |
| `auth_start_date` | the first date of service the authorization covers | YYYY-MM-DD; no empty value |
| `auth_end_date` | the last date of service the authorization covers | YYYY-MM-DD; no empty value |

**Return.** On success the result reads `status` "authorized", with `wc_event_id` (the reference number of the new authorization entry), `wc_case_id`, `auth_reference`, `hours`, `sessions`, `auth_start_date`, `auth_end_date` and `authorized_visits_remaining` (the authorized evaluation hours unused on the referral afterwards). The adjuster then sees the new authorization in force on the referral.
